name: Birdwatcher Eilidh

intro.text: There are white-tailed sea eagles on Skye. They're the biggest bird of prey in Britain, with a wingspan of 2.4 metres. I'm in a very small tent. It's a little humbling.

win: Beautiful. I'll write it down in the log, in pencil.
after: They were wiped out in Britain by 1918, and brought back in the 1970s. That's what we call a comeback.
